{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The workflow currently performs a fresh 'npm install' on every run. Since the repository contains a 'package-lock.json' (implied by the presence of 'package.json' and standard Node.js workflows), adding 'actions/cache@v4' to cache the npm global cache directory will reduce dependency download time. This follows the pattern of repairing configuration smells to improve CI performance.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test Pull Request

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm run test

      - name: Build language implementation
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run examples with the built language implementation
        run: npm run test:examples:cli
"
}
